---
name: frontend-design
description: Create distinctive, accessible, responsive frontend interfaces. Use for any frontend or UI task.
---

1. Plan first: purpose, audience, and one clear aesthetic direction.
2. Be distinctive: deliberate typography, a cohesive palette, avoid generic layouts.
3. Accessibility: semantic HTML, ARIA only where needed, contrast, keyboard and focus states, reduced motion.
4. Responsive: mobile first, test narrow and wide viewports.
5. Self-critique: review the result against the plan before finishing.
